## Spatial predictions of diarrhea and ATE
```{r}

#-------------------------------
# data frames for
# mortality spatial modeling
#-------------------------------
df_all; df_tx1; df_tx2; df_tx3

#-------------------------------
# fit spatial models for
# mortality rate
# strata 1: age group of deaths
# strata 2: treatment arm
#-------------------------------

for (agegroup in c("1to59","1to11","12to59")) {
  
  i=0
  
  for (txarm in list(df_all, df_tx1, df_tx2, df_tx3)) {
    
    assign(paste0("fitmort_",agegroup,"_",i),
           create_fitme(df = txarm, age = agegroup))
    i=i+1
    
  }
  
}
```

###  Q: WHICH AGE GROUP ARE WE USING FOR MORTALITY?
#### Indicate this for plot_materncor and b_preds.
```{r}

df_s0 <- fitmort_1to59_0
df_s1 <- fitmort_1to59_1
df_s2 <- fitmort_1to59_2
df_s3 <- fitmort_1to59_3

```


```{r}
#--------------------------------------
# generate and store
# matern correlation plots per strata
#--------------------------------------
materncorr_s0  <- plot_matern_corr(df_s0, "avenir-materncorr-s0")
materncorr_s1  <- plot_matern_corr(df_s1, "avenir-materncorr-s1")
materncorr_s2  <- plot_matern_corr(df_s2, "avenir-materncorr-s2")
materncorr_s3  <- plot_matern_corr(df_s3, "avenir-materncorr-s3")

```

```{r}
#--------------------------------------
# get model predictions on a grid
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_s0 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
                                  spamm_model_fit = df_s0)

b_preds_mort_s1 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
                                  spamm_model_fit = df_s1)

b_preds_mort_s2 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
                                  spamm_model_fit = df_s2)

b_preds_mort_s3 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
                                  spamm_model_fit = df_s3)

#--------------------------------------
# convert predicted surface of the mean
# to a raster to make it a regular
# set of tiles (rather than points), 
# then to tibble for ggplot2
# scale prevalence by 100
# to be in units of percent (%)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_coords_s0 <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_s0)
b_preds_mort_coords_s1 <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_s1)
b_preds_mort_coords_s2 <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_s2)
b_preds_mort_coords_s3 <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_s3)

b_preds_mort_raster_s0 <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_s0[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_s0[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_s0$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_s1 <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_s1[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_s1[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_s1$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_s2 <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_s2[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_s2[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_s2$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_s3 <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_s3[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_s3[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_s3$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster2_s0 <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_s0)
b_preds_mort_raster2_s1 <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_s1)
b_preds_mort_raster2_s2 <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_s2)
b_preds_mort_raster2_s3 <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_s3)

```
